entities.summary: Michael David Pfeifer O.M.I. is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of the Diocese of San Angelo in Texas from 1985 to 2012. He is a member of the Missionary Oblates of Mary Immaculate (Oblates).
